content_md:
One of the FOSS Gods, [Kailash Nadh](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DAiJD3cGFN8) on Vishnu's Podcast

Despite the reductive title, this was one of the most densely packed conversations of wisdom + experience that I've ever listened to.

They touch on the most important concepts of our time:

- growing up, tinkering on dialup as a teen, which opened up opportunities from Kerala to Britain and back home
- got his AI PhD in 2011
- building Zerodha on FOSS, non-proprietary self-hosted stack
- patient capital/perennial capital
- privacy as ethical choice, and a human right enshrined in Indian law
- impact of climate change on the India he loves
- LLMs allow a senior engineer to learn-build-iterate in one loop. he could start an ambitious new project in a new language in weeks, rather than 6-8 months 
- impossible to fix Big social media 

---

Dr. Nadh observes his own values, and asks, "How can it be ethical for me to build a product that violates all of this?"

Zerodha has:
- zero trackers
- no A/B testing to increase click-through ratios
- no push notifications

---
